svg.title: A language model in pure NumPy. Decoder-only transformer on my own autograd engine: RoPE, grouped-query attention, SwiGLU, QK-Norm and a KV-cache. Pretrained on DailyDialog, then tuned on EmpatheticDialogues. 3.87M parameters · 78 unit tests.

g.text: A language model in pure NumPy
Decoder-only transformer on my own autograd engine: RoPE,
grouped-query attention, SwiGLU, QK-Norm and a KV-cache.
Pretrained on DailyDialog, then tuned on EmpatheticDialogues.
